config.expectation_format: per-candidate expected rank + expected weighted score per source class, recorded before implementation; brief-supplied human expectations take precedence for their class
config.implementation: parallel per-proposal implementations; tests run per individual proposal; their results are the round-2 evidence base
config.evidence_equalization: the round-2 evidence set is identical for every voter; its sha256 is stamped on the round-2 receipt and required on every round-2 ballot
config.calibration: round-2 outcome vs the recorded input expectations; deltas with the evidence that moved them; the feed for the weights (#1489) and outcome (#1487) ledgers
config.not_run_rule: a stage that cannot execute is recorded specified_not_run in the cycle record - never dropped, never fabricated
config.facilitator_feedback: after round 1 the facilitator issues an anonymous synthesis from the ballots’ own rationales; a DEBATE / revision round is callable on it (revised ballots carry rationale, cited sources, revision_reason); uncalled = specified_not_run
config.ballot_reasons: every ballot carries rationale + evidence_refs; supplied ballots without them are refused at intake
